removed_claims.claim: During per-tile migration, some tiles still admit through EMS2 while others already use CES. Upper applications and shared containers call a single functional permission check. Replacing the provider wholesale would have forced caller changes; keeping only the EMS2 provider would have hidden CES grants. The union keeps the functional check stable across the transition while [[concepts/per-tile-provider-selection]] governs which provider admits each tile.
removed_claims.replacement: The migration intent supports EMS2 and CES tile-admission choices while preserving the existing shared permission API. The mapped grant union accepts either provider and logs its source. [[concepts/per-tile-provider-selection]] retains the separate tile-admission rule.
removed_claims.note: Replaced unsupported inevitable caller-change counterfactual with explicit source intent.
